name: What is the process for replacing a roof with Cali View Builders?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing a roof with Cali View Builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our roof replacement process begins with a comprehensive inspection and consultation to assess your current roof's condition and discuss material options. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal. Once approved, our team schedules the project, handles necessary permits, and manages material delivery. The old roof is removed, any necessary repairs to the roof deck are made, and the new roofing system is expertly installed. Finally, we conduct a thorough site cleanup and a final inspection to ensure your complete satisfaction. Throughout the process, we maintain clear communication.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes an inspection, proposal, permitting, old roof removal, new roof installation, and final cleanup/inspection. We keep you informed at every step.
